transcript_class: CAPTURE-TIME VERBATIM RECORD — paste of the Overview expanded, with its source cards
d: NANOPUBLICATIONS, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'the smallest independent unit of publishable scientific information, represented as a machine-readable knowledge graph snippet rather than a traditional research paper.' The structure in three parts (assertion, provenance, publication info), four features (machine-readable in RDF and OWL, citable and attributed on a decentralized network, a life-sciences focus with 'millions' created, nanopub-py and the nanopublications site). Nine cards: nanopub.net, the nanopub-py repository, the retired Research Object page, IEEE Xplore, an NIH-hosted paper, Research Ideas and Outcomes, the Pensoft blog, the nanopub documentation, a Medium essay.
reading: The innocent reading first. The Overview defines the unit, gives its three parts, says where it is used and how to make one.
findings: THE MODEL HELD. The definition and the three parts are nanopub.net's: provenance 'describes how the assertion above came to be'; publication info is 'when and by whom it was created and the license terms for its reuse' (census quotes). Checked 2026-10-29 against the provenance census record of the same day and the sources it saved.

'MILLIONS'. The record gives no count. The figure is at the grain of card 5 ('There are millions of nanopublications currently available on the Web, especially in the life science domain'); the composition's 'heavily concentrated in fields like genetics, pharmacology, and bioinformatics' raises 'especially' and names three disciplines no card names. (Repaired 2026-10-29: the finding had called the figure unchecked.)

WHAT IS NOT GIVEN. The second-generation Registry and Query services, which the record carries from nanopub.net's architecture page (updated 2026-10-28), are absent, as is the legacy server that keeps old unsigned nanopublications. Signing is absent too; the record carries it only by implication ('old (unsigned) nanopublications'), though the page it saved names it.
A RETIRED PAGE AMONG THE CARDS. The Research Object card carries its own notice that the RO-Crate site superseded it after 2020 and that the pages are no longer maintained.
analysis: The model is composed from its own definition at full grain. The record's two negative tags, that the model carries provenance without measuring its survival and that publication does not settle an assertion's truth, are neither stated nor contradicted: the composition says 'citable and attributed' and stops there.
per_note: No person or institution named in the answer (Groth et al. 2010 appears only in a card); no identifier; nanopub.net cited.

originator.basis: Not the archive's: Nanopublications; its operator, as the record gives it: the nanopublication community (nanopub.net). Formalized by the provenance meta-aggregator record of 2026-10-29 (https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/nanopublications/), editor Lee Sharks; the record's fields carry verbatim quotes from the sources it saved with sha256, each with its basis (the operator's own page or a third-party account). Recorded 2026-10-29; repaired the same day.
